reviews.title: Glad I chose this one
reviews.comment: Runs my RTX 5080 and my i9 14900k seamlessless with lights and other accessories perfectly. This thing is a monster. She fits perfectly, actually better than I had expected when doing a measurement check before I ordered. It is quiet and I had to actually shine my light on it to be sure it was actually running ideally. Connections were perfect and sturdy.
reviews.author: Alec

reviews.title: Great PSU, flexible wires and easy cable routing
reviews.comment: This PSU is not too long compared to other 1000W units but it also has plugs on the side which makes it quite short so it should be compatible with a lot of cases even if the max supported PSU length is short. The cables it comes with are quite flexible which makes it easy to route around the case. And the cables don't have inline capacitors so it's easy to bend around near the plug. The PSU fan also barely ever turns on. The zero RPM fan mode is really great and is the best implementation across all of the other manufacturers I've seen.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: I mean, it works
reviews.comment: I'd expect good quality for a $200 power supply, and I haven't felt I wasted my money. The modular design is good, it was easy to install, and the damn thing is so quiet I can't hear it. Runs a 7900 XTX just fine. Looks decent too, though that's not really critical for a PSU. If I had one tiny complaint, it's that I wish they had given one or two more of the standalone 8-pin connectors rather than the 8 pin + 8 pin connectors, makes it a little annoying to hook up a 7900 and looks worse when it's done, but ultimately it still works fine.
reviews.author: Adam Schlesener

reviews.title: Does NOT fit a Fractal Design Torrent case
reviews.comment: I have a Fractal Design Torrent mid-tower case where the PSU goes on top, but the frame of the case is too close to the side of the RM1000x Shift PSU where the cables plug in, so you can't fit any cables in there as the gap is too small. It seems this area was made for PSUs with the normal rear connections as there is ample space behind the PSU. So double check how much clearance you have where the cables plug into the PSU. I'm sure it's a great PSU, I've had Corsair PSUs for 15 years and never had a problem. I ended up going with a Corsair HX850 (cables on the rear, not the side like the Shift series), it has more than enough power (850w is more than enough unless you have an insane rig) and is also platinum rated whereas RMX series is gold rated. Model number I got is CP-9020138-NA.
reviews.author: Northwest

reviews.title: didn't realize i bought a used model and if it weren't for the box i'd never have known
reviews.comment: everything inside the box was in new condition, not like new, new. it came with an excess of cables and was easy to install, supplies ample power and was great for the price.
